stemMd: Which action is an example of a citizen exercising a political right in a representative democracy?

options.label: B
options.textMd: Voting in a public election when legally entitled to do so

explanationMd: Voting selects public representatives or determines public questions through the electoral process. It is a political form of participation. The other actions are ordinary private activities rather than exercises of an electoral right.

distractorRationale.a: This does not itself select public representatives.
distractorRationale.e: This is a private consumption choice.
